carousel.alt: Rows of young plants under greenhouse hoops. Planting starts with a plan. Tell Congress.
A field of green hemp plants. Before the seed goes in the ground, farmers order seed, commit acreage and line up buyers.
Harvesters in a broad field. A crop needs a buyer. Uncertain rules can put farm and manufacturing plans on hold.
Give farmers time to plan. Ask Congress to include proposed hemp certainty language in the next federal funding bill.

feed.alt: Hands tending a tall hemp crop. The businesses behind hemp. Some hemp businesses could be forced to close. Tell Congress before December 11.

story.alt: Hands tending a tall hemp crop. The businesses behind hemp. Some hemp businesses could be forced to close. Tell Congress before December 11.

carousel.alt: Hands tending a tall hemp crop. The businesses behind hemp. Some hemp businesses could be forced to close. Tell Congress before December 11.
A worker’s hands tending hemp. A crop. A paycheck. A business built here. The new rules put real decisions in front of affected businesses.
Make sure Congress hears from us. Tell your representative what a workable plan for hemp would mean in your community.
